site.name: Lelek Studio
site.tagline: Shaped by hand, guided by instinct
site.description: Lelek Studio is the ceramic practice of Przemyslaw Golebiewski - a self-taught ceramist from rural Poland, working in Berlin. Handmade functional ceramics, vessels and wall objects shaped by intuition, earth, water, fire and air.

hero.headline: Shaped by hand,
hero.quote: Kazde ziarno piasku jest tez inne...
hero.subheadline: Functional ceramics, vessels and wall objects made in Berlin. Each piece shaped slowly - by material, process and use.
hero.imageAlt: Lelek Studio Berlin - handmade stoneware ceramics and wall objects by ceramist Przemyslaw Golebiewski

story.heading: From peatlands
story.imageAlt: Przemyslaw Golebiewski - ceramist at the wheel, Clay Stories Berlin
story.body1: As a small boy I always followed the pull of nature - that was where I felt safe. Spending hours wandering through the wilderness of the village where I grew up, I forgot about the rest of the world. Only here and now mattered.
story.body2: Not far from my family home stretched wide peatlands, home to different animals, the sounds of nature, and probably other presences I was not aware of. I slipped away there whenever I could, into my second world, where it was only me, the material things of nature, and whatever lay beyond them.
story.body3: I never got to finish art school, but that did not stop me from searching for a way to express what I often could not put into words - maybe I still cannot. I am self-taught. I work intuitively, whether painting or working with clay. In Berlin, the community in different studios showed me the tools and how to use them. The rest is a process of discovery, of listening to my own intuition. Maybe that is why I almost never make identical things. Every grain of sand is different too...

process.heading: Made slowly,
process.imageAlt: Ceramist Przemyslaw Golebiewski at the wheel, Clay Stories Berlin studio
process.body1: Each functional piece starts on the wheel - shaped, trimmed, glazed by hand. Wall objects are built differently: through intuitive handbuilding, form emerging from the material rather than the wheel.
process.body2: Small batches, slow process, made at Clay Stories Berlin. The glaze is applied by hand and fired at high temperature - the result is always slightly different from what was planned, and better for it.
